_comment: Seeded by software-start so audit-software's incremental mode works from day 1. lastAuditCommit=null means 'never audited' -> the first audit run is effectively a full sweep. The profile is shared with audit-software's Step 0 so it doesn't re-derive it.

profile.stack: Bash/shell + Apache/MySQL/PHP config; bats (test), shellcheck (lint), gitleaks (secret-scan); Ansible possible later
profile.dataSensitivity: auth secrets / server credentials handled at runtime (DB roots, SSH keys, TLS); no end-user PII stored by the toolkit itself
profile.exposure: configures a public-internet LAMP server; the repo is a published/shared toolkit
profile.deployModel: self-hosted single box (runs on the target Ubuntu server); published toolkit
